in_marathi.name: Atanu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Not attained, unfulfilled
in_marathi.long_meaning: Atanu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Atanu means 'not attained' or 'unfulfilled'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'anu' which means 'not' or 'towards' and 'at' meaning 'reached'. In Hindu mythology, Atanu is the name of a king and a devotee of Lord Krishna.
